description: This file implements a command-line flag parsing utility, including definitions for flags, aliases, processing logic, and XML output for flags, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: Flag
classes.description: Represents a command-line flag with support for aliases, help text, getter/setter functions, and XML output.

classes.name: FlagAlias
classes.description: Represents an alias for a command-line flag, including its mode and name.

methods.name: operator<< (const FlagAlias&)
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of a FlagAlias, including its mode and name.

methods.name: operator<< (const Flag&)
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of a Flag, including its aliases, help text, and current value.

methods.name: ArgsToVec
methods.description: Converts command-line arguments from argc/argv to a vector of strings.

methods.name: FlagVerbosity
methods.description: Creates a flag for setting verbosity level, with getter and setter functions.

methods.name: HelpXmlFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag that outputs all flags in XML format when triggered.

methods.name: InvalidFlagGuard
methods.description: Creates a flag that indicates only '-help' is supported, with a setter that reports unknown flags.

methods.name: UnexpectedArgumentGuard
methods.description: Creates a flag that indicates positional arguments are not supported, with a setter that reports unexpected arguments.

methods.name: GflagsCompatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag compatible with gflags, with various overloads for different types.

methods.name: ParseInteger
methods.description: Template function to parse an integer value from a string.

methods.name: GflagsCompatNumericFlagGeneric
methods.description: Template function to create a numeric gflags-compatible flag.

methods.name: GflagsCompatBoolFlagSetter
methods.description: Sets a boolean flag based on a key-value pair from command-line arguments.

methods.name: GflagsCompatBoolFlagBase
methods.description: Creates a base boolean flag with common aliases.
